+import sys

+
+
+API_URL = \"https://api.openai.com/v1/responses\"
+
+
+def send_prompt(prompt, model=\"gpt-4.1-mini\", api_key=None, timeout=60):
+    \"\"\"Return the text response to a prompt without requesting storage.\"\"\"
+    if not isinstance(prompt, str) or not prompt.strip():
+        raise ValueError(\"prompt must be nonempty text\")
+    key = api_key if api_key is not None else os.environ.get(\"OPENAI_API_KEY\")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError(\"set OPENAI_API_KEY or pass api_key\")
+
+    payload = json.dumps({\"model\": model, \"input\": prompt, \"store\": False}).encode(\"utf-8\")
+    request = Request(
+        API_URL,
+        data=payload,
+        headers={\"Authorization\": \"Bearer \" + key, \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"},
+        method=\"POST\",
+    )
+    try:
+        with urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
+            result = json.load(response)
+    except HTTPError as error:
+        raise RuntimeError(f\"OpenAI API returned HTTP {error.code}\") from None
+    except URLError:
+        raise RuntimeError(\"Could not connect to the OpenAI API\") from None
+    except (UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+        raise RuntimeError(\"OpenAI API returned invalid JSON\") from None
+
+    if result.get(\"status\") "'!= "completed":
+        raise RuntimeError("OpenAI API response was not completed")
+    texts = [
+        content["text"]
+        for item in result.get("output", [])
+        for content in item.get("content", [])
+        if content.get("type") == "output_text" and isinstance(content.get("text"), str)
+    ]
+    if not texts:
+        raise RuntimeError("OpenAI API response contained no text")
+    return "".join(texts)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--model", default="gpt-4.1-mini", help="OpenAI model ID")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    prompt = getpass.getpass("Prompt: ") if sys.stdin.isatty() else sys.stdin.read()
+    try:
+        print(send_prompt(prompt, model=args.model))
+    except (ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
+        parser.exit(1, f"Error: {error}'"\\n\")
+
+
+if __name__ == \"__main__\":
+    main()
